fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Board (Ministry of Railway) has released Answer Key for the recruitment of Technician Grade-I & Grade-III on the official website of the RRBs. This recruitment was released for 6565 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB Technician Recruitment 2026 were accepted from June 30, 2026, to July 29, 2026. The CBT-I examination was on 06-09 October 2026. Candidates who had appeared for this exam can download their Railway RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date : 29 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 06-09 October 2026
  • Exam City Details : 27 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 04 Days Before Exam
  • Answer Key : 15 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General : Rs. 400/-
  • OBC, EWS, SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.
